items.title: Show HN: A local merge queue for parallel Claude Code agents
items.summary: I have been pushing up to 90 commits a day on a MacBook Air via 4-5 parallel agents. As you can imagine when all the agents try to build, test and run dev servers on an 8GB machine it is the fast lane to a force quit and restart. I also did not want to pay the CI minutes on 90 pushes a day. So I designed a local merge queue to have all commits land one at a time and fully tested. Hopefully this helps other folks with more modest machines. Appreciate any feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49104747 Points: 28 # Comments: 8
